title: Retire lane trust while preserving paths outside Yoke-managed roots.
verification: Candidate source uses path ownership and the harness registry for exact-path retirement and a backed-up deleted-lane sweep. Regression tests cover all three harnesses, outside paths, live paths and repeat runs; machine cleanup and registration evidence belong to the item. Source regressions cover exact UTF-8 byte counts and backups for LF and CRLF configurations; Codex edits preserve unaffected bytes and detect line-ending-only concurrent writes. JSON updates use deterministic LF bytes.
